nodes.text: With that in mind, I think we all know who the winner of today is...

nodes.text: Remind me again, why do we need an appointment to buy a tux? Couldn't we just show up?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hahaha! Just show up! What are we, beggars?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It might be a bad sign that I make you laugh the most when I'm not actually telling a joke...

nodes.text: For the dinner with your mom and Tad?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh, yeah.

nodes.text: I didn't think Tad had much of a sense of humor...

nodes.text: He doesn't.

nodes.text: And when do you care about making him laugh?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So just do something nice for me because I asked you to!

nodes.speaker: Owen

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No. Shut up. And stop smiling.

nodes.text: Just tell the joke.

nodes.text: I don't remember which one I'm going to!

nodes.text: Good enough?

nodes.text: Bravo.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But I ended up coming in late. See, I had to go back to my rich house...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Because I fell and got dirt all over my fur coat!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Get it? It's ironic because I would never wear a fur coat, let alone while riding a bike!

nodes.text: That joke was wrong in a hundred different ways!

nodes.text: Rich people don't ride bicycles! We have butlers do that for us!

nodes.text: We don't have jobs either! We're `way` too important to do stuff!

nodes.text: No! That joke wasn't even funny for people who could understand it!

nodes.text: Heh. That tickles.

nodes.text: Don't embarrass me anymore than you already have.

nodes.text: It's kind of a constant thing with you.

nodes.speaker: Owen

nodes.text: Owen!

nodes.text: Where was I? Oh yes! Your assignment for today!

nodes.text: In order to demonstrate what life was like in medieval times, we are going to run an experiment!

nodes.text: First, let's divide the class into two groups. This half is Team One. This half is Team Two.

nodes.text: Do they still represent caution?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: Uh... I'll choose to ignore that.

nodes.text: So then, how do we get the stupid cones?

nodes.text: What's up?
